name: Pea Milk
siboNotes: Pea milk is generally well-tolerated as it's naturally FODMAP-free, but some brands may contain high-FODMAP additives like inulin or chicory root.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added sugars
Check ingredient labels for FODMAP-containing thickeners or sweeteners
Shake well before use as separation is natural
Can be used 1:1 as dairy milk replacement in most recipes
nutritionalHighlights: High in plant-based protein (8-10g per cup)
Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Lower in calories than dairy milk
